policy: Intended surface changes since the recorded baseline. Each entry: match (prefix of a tools/compat.py difference line), reason, finding (review/plan id). Behavior-preserving PRs add nothing here.

exceptions.reason: Correcting a suppressed memory item is refused; the owner must unsuppress explicitly.
A pinned memory item superseded by a newer item with the same conflict_key is surfaced as a conflict instead of being dropped.
